view.scene_description: An indoor supermarket aisle filled with shelves stocked with packaged snacks and frozen goods. Decorative hot air balloon and red lantern ornaments hang from the ceiling. Bright fluorescent lights illuminate the space. A refrigerated display case is visible in the background near large windows.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Multi-tiered metal shelving units filled with various snack products. Located on the left and center of the frame. Some items are in wire baskets. Shelves are supported by vertical metal frames. Partially occluded by hanging decorations above.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Yellow and white striped hot air balloon-shaped ornaments suspended from the ceiling. Visible in the upper right and center. Not touching any surfaces. Hanging freely from unseen points above.

objects.label: red lantern decorations
objects.observation: Red paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling on the right side. Near windows. Slightly out of focus. Not touching any surfaces. Hanging freely from unseen points above.

objects.label: fluorescent lights
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent light fixtures mounted to the black ceiling. Spanning across the top of the frame. Illuminating the entire scene. No visible supports other than ceiling mounting.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: Glass-fronted refrigerated unit on the far right. Contains food items inside. Positioned near large windows. Floor contact visible. Appears freestanding.

objects.label: windows
objects.observation: Large glass windows along the back wall on the right. Allow natural light into the store. Behind the refrigerated case. No visible frames or supports.

State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):

Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
